name: Default
shortDescription: AI answer engine with a generative UI, backed by PostgreSQL, Redis and a private SearXNG instance, with built-in multi-user accounts.

alerts.message: Set at least one AI provider in the environment (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY, OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY with OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_BASE_URL, AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY or OLLAMA_BASE_URL) and redeploy; without one no model can be selected.

The first account created at /auth/sign-up becomes the admin, and sign-up stays open to anyone afterwards. Create it right after deploying, or set BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL first so only that address can claim it; then set AUTH_SIGNUP_MODE to invite and redeploy to require invitations.
HTTPS is required: session cookies are marked secure, so sign-in does not persist on a plain HTTP URL.
